name: Luna
source: Jon's childhood friend and only female friend. Used to be in the same kindergarten as Jon. She has the power of turning people into a small mochi like being (Jon was once a victim of this power). She should be able to make people into other things, but doesn't seem to know how. She is the daughter of a famous actress. Her P.E.T is a snake called 'Ular'.
